claims.statement: A related Sibeile IMR18500 1100mAh black sample was documented at approximately 18 mm x 68 mm with a PTC, but no exact physical or terminal evidence was found for this separate 22A catalog revision.
Steam Engine preserves Sibeile IMR 18500 1100mAh 22A as a 1100mAh preset with a 22A runtime rating.

The Sibeile IMR 18500 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Sibeile IMR 18500 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-10-04 or earlier.
